name: scripts-integration
//: The release scripts driven against local registries: the probe over HTTP and publish.sh against a local npm registry. Slow, so behind its own edge to the two scripts it drives, and it holds its own 95% line floor over the probe (measured through its subprocess runs) rather than joining python-coverage, which would run it for every Python change.

options.command: uv run --frozen --no-sync ruff format --quiet --config scripts/release/ruff.toml scripts/release/tests
uv run --frozen --no-sync ruff format --quiet --check --config scripts/release/ruff.toml scripts/release/tests
uv run --frozen --no-sync ruff check --quiet --config scripts/release/ruff.toml scripts/release/tests
